summary: AIOps walking skeleton: MCP Tool Gateway (mcp-server/) over stdio + HTTP with a read-only SQL Server DMV tool, a reliability layer (timeout/retry/circuit breaker), a live dashboard, and a remediation guardrail (guardrails/) requiring human approval before any corrective action.
note: Status per requirement (UNMAPPED/PLANNED/BUILT) and the acceptance criteria backing each test are documented in requirementsFile — this summary doesn't assert a verdict, it points at the real evidence.
